The company’s objectives are to provide a comprehensive range of distinctive programmes and services with the view to inform, educate, entertain, support and develop culture in all 11 official langu ages. Currently, the company’s principal activities comprise of Television and Radio broadcasting utilising 19 radio stations and 5 television channels. All these offerings should be kept running for 24 hours a day in line with the mandate and agreed strategic operations parameters of the organisation 2 REQUIREMENTS AND SCOPE OF SERVICES SABC has been using legacy session management software for management of multiple sessions to z-Series and printing support for the last 30 years.
